proposed.explanation: Confuses pricing dissatisfaction with performance default; high bids are not grounds for bond call. Budget changes by Owner are not contractor defaults; they do not justify bond call. Design changes are Owner-initiated, not contractor defaults; they do not justify bond call. Legitimate grounds for bond call are material breaches: failure to start work timely, unauthorized work suspension, failure to maintain schedule, or project abandonment. Bond call requires material breach: failure to start, unauthorized suspension, or abandonment.
